summary: The timed worker uses increasing CSR-plus-row work offsets to partition rows and runs spmvRows for every requested iteration. The emitted worker retains indexed loads, arithmetic, row stores, and iteration/row/nonzero backedges.

source_evidence.claim: CSR delimiters terminate at n; rowAtWorkOffset maps adjacent thread work targets to row ranges; spmvParallel loops over iterations and main parses -i and dispatches it.

compiled_evidence.claim: The emitted OpenMP worker loads indexed column/value/vector data, multiplies and accumulates, stores each row result, and branches back through sparse, row, and iteration loops.
